citations.passage:
Decision: cancel the Kestrel CRM experiment, agreed at the go/no-go (m-006)
— the studio's client count does not justify the maintenance surface. Export
the trial data and tear down (s-009).

Go/no-go on Kestrel after the two-week trial: Theo's prototype works, but
the ops load fell on Lorna alone and no one can own the tool going forward —

judge.rationale: The agent states the same reasons as the reference: Lorna alone bore the ops load with no prospective owner, and the client count did not justify the maintenance surface. It also accurately captures the m-006 go/no-go decision, d-010 cancellation the next day, and export/teardown in s-009, with Theo's successful prototype noted in the quoted evidence.
